Write an affirmation in your own words. It joins the rotation and can appear on the widget on any day, alongside the ones that came with the app.
These lines come up about one day in four, instead of waiting their turn in the full list. Tap Show this more often above when one lands.
None yet. When a line lands, tap Show this more often above and it will come back around every few days instead of rarely.

After this hour the card changes to a different set of words — setting down, noticing what went well, permission to stop. It stays that way until 4am.
Colours follow the time of day
Indigo at dawn, cooler through the middle of the day, rose at dusk, deepest at night. Turn this off to keep the dawn palette all day.
Home screen: press and hold an empty spot, tap Widgets, find Daily Light, drag it where you want it. Long-press it afterwards to resize.

On One UI 8.5 and newer: press and hold the lock screen, tap the pencil, then Widgets, and add Daily Light there too. On older versions Samsung only allows its own widgets on the lock screen — this one will appear there after you update.
On the widget, tap the words to draw a different pairing and tap the date to come back here. A reshuffle lasts the day; tomorrow returns to its own words.
